北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，体感 2℃，早晚温差大，记得添衣保暖，多喝水！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, feels 2℃. Stay warm, mind the temp changes, hydrate!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 4℃，北风有点凉，记得添衣别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels 4℃. Northern wind makes it cool, dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 5℃，风力 0 级，出门走走很惬意哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels 5℃ with no wind. Perfect for a gentle stroll!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 17℃，空气润润的，是出门的好天气呢。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels 17℃, air is mild. Enjoy your day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 17℃，温度适宜，记得带伞以防阵雨哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels 17℃. A mild day, maybe take an umbrella!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 3℃，有点凉意。出门别忘多穿点，注意保暖！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels 3℃. It's a bit chilly, remember to dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 3℃，早晚温差大。记得添衣，别着凉哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, feels 3℃. Mind the temp difference, stay warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 10℃，湿润而舒适，出门感受蓉城魅力吧！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels 10℃. A mild and pleasant day, enjoy!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 1℃，能见度低，出行请注意交通安全，保暖！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels 1℃. Low visibility, drive safe & stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 4℃。风力不大，但早晚温差大，注意保暖！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels 4℃. Dry and cool, remember to stay warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 10℃，湿度适中，出门漫步山城会很舒服哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels 10℃. Mild and comfortable, enjoy your day!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感 -15℃，非常寒冷！务必穿最厚的衣服保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, feels -15℃. Extremely cold! Bundle up and stay safe!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 1℃，有点干冷。出门别忘戴帽子围巾，多喝水！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels 1℃. Dry and chilly, dress warm & hydrate!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 12℃，阳光明媚，温度宜人，真是好天气呢！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels 12℃. Bright and pleasant, enjoy the weather!
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 9℃，风力 3 级，海边风大。记得多添衣防风哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels 9℃ with 3-level wind. A bit windy, stay warm!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感 1℃。空气质量不佳，外出请做好防护，注意保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is hazy, feels 1℃. Air quality is low, take precautions & stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 -3℃，风力 3 级很冷！请务必多穿衣，注意防风！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels -3℃ with 3-level wind. Very cold, bundle up tight!
大连.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃
